after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-carnillean.npc: Hello again, adventurer! It's good to see you! If it wasn't for your quick thinking, the treacherous Jones would have probably poisoned my family and I by now! We are in your debt.

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-carnillean.player: Don't worry about it! A good deed is its own reward. And that money didn't hurt either.

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.npc: Oh... I may be wrong... but ever since I asked for your help, things around here have gone from bad to worse...
I think you'd better keep out of my way. And for the last time, it's Sir Ceril! Sir! It's not that hard to blooming remember!
